title: Houston wind max -> CF abs return (3d)
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Houston daily max wind 20d z-score > 1 leads CF absolute returns (volatility) by 3 days (+) via Gulf Coast ammonia outage uncertainty rather than direction; trade long CF straddle-proxy 5d [weather.houston.wind_max -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0051)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.houston.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 4 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: Houston daily max wind 20d z-score > 1 leads CF intraday range pct by 2 days (+) only if Gulf ammonia weather disruption is real; expect no excess over baseline volatility; trade long CF straddle-proxy 3d [weather.houston.wind_max -> finance.CF.range_pct] (parent: R2-0151)
